title: Introducing Spyglass: Enhanced Insights for Everyone
summary: We're thrilled to announce the full launch of Spyglass, delivering cutting-edge analytics to empower your daily work with powerful new insights.

title: Advanced File Management
summary: Gain complete control over your content with new tools that allow you to easily manage, upload, and customize how files appear directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap page provides a transparent look at our past accomplishments, current development, and exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Experience a more intuitive and efficient way to manage your tasks with our enhanced checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable.

title: Smarter Collaboration Experience
summary: We've elevated your team's collaboration with intuitive tools and clearer syncing, making real-time teamwork smoother and more connected than ever.

title: Discover Shared Content Instantly
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on shared items with a powerful new search experience that surfaces all relevant content you have access to.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in the project's future.

title: Unlock Noeko in Your Language
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we introduce comprehensive support for a wide array of international languages, making our platform accessible to a global audience.

title: Stunning New Themes & Visual Refinements
summary: Experience a stunning refresh with beautiful new themes and improved existing designs, crafted to personalize your workspace.

title: Unlock Deeper Insights with Enhanced Map Filtering
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your knowledge map with dynamic filters for tags, time, and shared items, transforming it into an indispensable tool for discovery and productivity.

title: Enhanced Search & Personalized Collections
summary: Effortlessly refine your knowledge with powerful new search filters, including tags and time ranges, and save your custom results as personalized collections for quick access to exactly what you need.

title: Dynamic Note Views
summary: We're introducing dynamic ways to visualize your linked content, providing flexible layouts to make your notes more intuitive and interactive.

title: Noeko Self-Hosted and Enhanced Enterprise Editions
summary: Gain ultimate control by deploying Noeko on your own servers or access enhanced capabilities with our new flexible cloud-hosted and enterprise plans.

title: Always the Right Greeting
summary: Experience a more personalized welcome as our app now accurately displays greetings that perfectly align with your local time of day.

title: Effortless Tag Organization
summary: Efficiently manage your tagged content by easily unapplying tags, deleting items, or viewing details directly from any tag list, saving you valuable time and clicks.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly add and interact with diverse content formats, like YouTube videos, websites, and text files, making it easier than ever to gather and organize all your valuable information.
